title: Shopify moves back to Native from React Native
why_read: A major company reversing a widely-adopted cross-platform framework decision is a genuinely useful data point for engineers evaluating React Native versus native mobile development.
analysis: Shopify is apparently moving parts of its mobile app back from React Native to native iOS/Android code, reversing an earlier bet on cross-platform tooling. This kind of real-world engineering retrospective is valuable because it surfaces the practical tradeoffs, performance issues, or maintenance costs that pushed a large, sophisticated team away from React Native. These postmortems tend to carry more weight than marketing content because they come with production-scale experience. Engineers making similar framework choices will find concrete lessons here.
